correctness.rationale: Fourier diagonalization is explicit, ordering folded phases gives the exact adjacent cosine gap families with no omitted boundary pairs, and the min of strictly increasing/decreasing branches has exactly one optimizer. Sharp constants follow by substitution, and the finite-T Cesaro estimate follows by integrating nonzero Fourier cross terms. Reproducible verifier passed 10064 checks. The spectral maximin theorem does not imply best actual mixing time.

value.rationale: The smallest energy splitting is an exact worst-resonance denominator in a general finite-time Cesaro dephasing bound. Determining its global flux maximizer over all Fourier pairs is structurally motivated, and the exact parity bifurcation π/2 versus π/3 plus the leading coefficient ratio 4/3 yields a nonvacuous all-size spectral design benchmark without claiming actual mixing-time optimality.
